meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 它会扫描项目，找出没有被其他代码引用的函数、变量、文件等，并自动确认它们确实没人用（跳过入口文件、测试等），然后把删除任务分成几批，由多个并行小助手同时清理，每批单独提交。
howto.when: 当用户要求移除无用代码、清理项目，或说出“remove dead code”“dead code”“cleanup”等触发词时触发。默认扫描整个项目，也可指定文件、目录或符号。

say.text: 清理这个项目里未使用的代码
say.note: 会先扫描并验证死代码后再删除。

say.text: 找出 src 目录中未被引用的函数并删除
检查一下有没有可删除的死代码
say.note: 如果没有会报告未发现。

howto.what_en: It scans the project for unused functions, variables, files, etc., verifies they have no references (skipping entry files, tests, etc.), then batches removal tasks to multiple parallel sub-agents and commits each batch separately.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to remove unused code, clean up the project, or says 'remove dead code', 'dead code', 'cleanup', etc. Defaults to a full project scan; can be scoped to a file, directory, or symbol.

say_en.text: Clean up unused code in this project
say_en.note: It will scan, verify, then delete dead code.

say_en.text: Find and delete unused functions in src
say_en.note: Scan is limited to that directory.

say_en.text: Check if there is any dead code to remove
say_en.note: If none, it will report that.
